properties.name_zh: 大钟寺无障碍换乘引导
properties.co_location_reason: The flagship accessibility case is evaluated at the mapped civic-verification interface; the duplicate point is intentional, not a second facility.
properties.urban_problem: Station-commercial precinct step-free route uncertainty and temporary obstruction.
properties.agent_action: Compare verified step-free route options, disclose uncertainty and hand off to a human service point.
properties.responsible_operator_type: registered mobility-information operator with station/public-space manager and staffed human fallback
properties.release_condition: Limited release only after route and entrance survey, published uncertainty, static equivalent route and staffed fallback are available.
properties.public_verification: Users verify the route between Release Gate, civic verification point and human appeal point; corrections are logged on site.
properties.conditional_trigger: Repeated user correction, stale lift/closure information or rising human intervention keeps the case conditional.
properties.rollback_condition: Any unsafe or inaccessible routing, material harm, or unavailable human fallback triggers immediate withdrawal to static guidance and human service.

properties.name_zh: 公共服务信息 Agent 发布—退场复核
properties.co_location_reason: The public-information case terminates at the mapped Retirement Memory archive point; the duplicate point is intentional, not a second facility.
properties.urban_problem: Station-area service information becomes stale, untraceable or unavailable to people without an app.
properties.agent_action: Answer bounded service and route questions from an approved directory, show source/date and offer paper or human fallback.
properties.responsible_operator_type: registered public-information operator with precinct manager, staffed service desk and independent complaint handler
properties.release_condition: Limited release only with an approved dated directory, bounded scope, source display, no profiling and a visible non-digital equivalent.
properties.public_verification: Users challenge answers at the civic verification and appeal points; accepted corrections update the public record.
properties.conditional_trigger: Repeated stale answers, unresolved complaints or excessive human intervention triggers recalibration.
properties.rollback_condition: Fabricated or harmful information, loss of source traceability, unavailable fallback or unresolved repeated complaints triggers withdrawal, public notice and data deletion review.
